# ==================== Emojis ====================
# ✨  :sparkles: New feature or record system
# 🔧  :wrench: Workflow or rule improvement
# ♻️  :recycle: Refactoring or reorganization
# 📚  :books: Documentation
# 🐛  :bug: Fix or correction
# 🎉  :tada: Initial commit
